# IEEE 802.3 (`dot3`)

- **Layer**: L2 (data link)
- **Header**: 14 octets (fixed)
- **Minimum frame**: 60 octets
- **Notes**: [L2 control protocols](../../protocols/l2-control.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) | `ethertype` | 0 (0x0000) – 1535 (0x05ff) (re-decodes this layer) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dst` | `mac` | `ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff` |   |   |
| `src` | `mac` | `02:00:00:00:00:01` |   |   |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the payload in octets |   |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `length`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| (any other value) | [`llc`](llc.md) |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| warning | `length` within 0..1500 |
